title: Read your match
subtitle: Chapter 6 of 9
instructions: Warm and plain spoken, like a friend showing you their app. Brisk and light on its feet, keeping things moving, but never rushed or clipped. No salesy lift at the end of sentences.

lines.text: Once the points are scored, the match reads itself back to you.
This is how the match actually swung, point by point.
Then the numbers. Serve, receive, the tight ends of games, your best run, and how it all finished.
And why you lost points, from the reasons you chose while scoring them.
When the ball can be tracked, you also get a map of where it landed.
Your serves or theirs, dots for each landing or a heat map, and one game at a time.
That part is still in beta, so if a map looks wrong you can say so and it stops counting.
